title: schema-checkpointing-for-partial-streams-and-sdk-compatibility-harness
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a synthetic test harness that validates JSON-mode enforcement and constrained-decoder behavior under realistic partial-stream scenarios and across SDK/runtime compatibility boundaries. The harness will simulate token-level interruption, deliberate token dropout, interleaved tool/function-calls, and incremental KV-cache resets to exercise decoder backoff heuristics and schema checkpoint/recovery logic. We will also run the harness against a compatibility matrix of runtime and SDK versions to detect regressions introduced by kernel scheduling or batching changes.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can inject token dropout at arbitrary byte offsets and rehydrate missing spans using replayed context
JSON-mode enforcer flags invalid partial emissions and triggers schema-checkpoint fallback paths within configured latency budgets
Constrained decoding backoff behavior produces either a valid fallback JSON document or a deterministic error sentinel, with telemetry hooks recorded
Compatibility matrix runs across runtime-1.18, runtime-1.20, and runtime-1.22 and SDKs v2.4.x and v2.7.x pass baseline golden suite without >1% unexplained failures
Automated nightly runs produce a digestable report and upload failure traces to the structured-output dashboard
tasks: Design token-slice checkpoint format for partial-stream recovery (proto + wire format)
Implement synthetic stream injector to simulate latency spikes, token dropout, and interleaved tool calls
Integrate with constrained-decoder harness to exercise backoff and sentinel emission policies
Create golden prompt suite covering nested objects, arrays, enums, and toolcall boundaries
Add compatibility runner that spins up multiple runtime/image combos and SDK permutations
Wire telemetry: failure tags, token-level diffs, and perf metrics to console structured-output dashboard
Author runbook for interpreting failure classes and recommended remediation steps
comments: 2025-02-11 - Asha Patel: Initial writeup and motivation. This grew out of customer incidents where partial streams produced syntactically invalid JSON that downstream consumers treated as success. We need deterministic recovery behavior.
2025-02-13 - Miguel Rivera: Proposed checkpoint format attached in attachment list. Wants to avoid heavy protos on the hot-path; prefer compact base64 slices with sequence numbers.
2025-02-14 - Design review (Elena Cho): UX note - error sentinels must include machine-readable reason codes to help Console correlate regressions with prompt sets.
2025-02-16 - Reliability (Samir Khan): Concern: injecting KV-cache resets may change performance profile. We'll run a limited run before enabling nightly full-matrix.

2025-02-18 - Miguel Rivera: Implemented prototype of injector and ran small golden suite against runtime-1.18 and runtime-1.22. Early results: runtime-1.22 shows higher incidence of truncated array tails under high batching; added a tuning task for kernel scheduler flags.
